title: Execute AGV command in Aveva API to recover when RMS missed an AGV completion callback
summary: When Geek+ RMS fails to send a completion callback (e.g., after an RMS crash/missed callback), use the Aveva API “Execute AGV command” recovery mechanism to mark the specified AGV task as completed by providing the full AGV ID.
when_to_use: Use when RMS fails to send a callback indicating an AGV task is complete, and you need a recovery mechanism that can mark the AGV task as done by specifying the full AGV ID via the Aveva API.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Aveva API “Execute AGV command” recovery mechanism by entering the full AGV ID and submitting the command; confirm the API response indicates acceptance/execution.
safety_notes: If the source indicates a restart-related safety note (E-stop before restart), follow it; do not proceed with restart actions without following the source safety note about E-stop.
access_or_tools_needed: Aveva API interface/page that includes the Geek+ RMS command set (includes “Execute AGV command”).
Full AGV ID value for the AGV whose task completed but whose callback was missed.

access_required: Authorized access to the Aveva API interface/page that exposes the Geek+ RMS command set.
system_preconditions: RMS has missed a callback (or RMS crash/missed callback condition is present) such that the AGV completion was not communicated via callback.

visual_references.description: Aveva API page showing recovery mechanisms including “Execute AGV command” and “Resend Geek Command”.

steps.title: Open the Aveva API interface/page that exposes the Geek+ RMS command set
steps.purpose: Access the recovery mechanism UI where “Execute AGV command” is available.
steps.instruction: Open the Aveva API interface/page that includes the Geek+ RMS command set (the page that contains the “Execute AGV command” recovery mechanism).
steps.expected_result: The Aveva API page is open and shows the recovery mechanism option labeled “Execute AGV command”.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Execute AGV command” option is visible on the Aveva API page.
steps.failure_condition: The Aveva API page does not show “Execute AGV command” (e.g., wrong page/section or access issue).

actions.label: Verify Execute AGV command is present
actions.exact_action: Locate the “Execute AGV command” recovery mechanism on the Aveva API page.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access the Aveva API page or cannot find “Execute AGV command”, stop and escalate for access/UI troubleshooting.

steps.title: Select the recovery mechanism labeled “Execute AGV command”
steps.purpose: Choose the correct recovery mechanism for marking an AGV task as completed after a missed RMS callback.
steps.instruction: On the Aveva API page, select the recovery mechanism labeled “Execute AGV command”.
steps.expected_result: The “Execute AGV command” mechanism is selected/active in the Aveva API interface.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI is positioned to accept the required input for “Execute AGV command” (AGV ID entry).
steps.failure_condition: You are not able to reach the input fields for “Execute AGV command” (e.g., wrong mechanism selected).
stop_or_escalate_if: If selecting “Execute AGV command” does not expose the AGV ID input, stop and escalate for UI troubleshooting.

steps.title: Enter the full AGV ID for the AGV whose task completed but whose callback was missed by RMS
steps.purpose: Provide the required identifier so the API can complete the action for the correct AGV.
steps.instruction: In the “Execute AGV command” input, enter the full AGV ID for the AGV whose task completed but whose callback was missed by RMS.
steps.expected_result: The full AGV ID value is entered into the “Execute AGV command” input field.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV ID field contains the full AGV ID (not truncated).
steps.failure_condition: The AGV ID is missing, incomplete, or cannot be entered/validated by the UI.

actions.label: Enter full AGV ID
actions.exact_action: Specify the full AGV ID for the AGV whose task completed when RMS fails to send a callback.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you do not have the full AGV ID, stop and obtain the correct full AGV ID before executing the command.

steps.title: Submit/execute the “Execute AGV command” for the specified AGV ID
steps.purpose: Trigger the recovery mechanism so the software completes the action for the specified AGV ID.
steps.instruction: Submit/execute the “Execute AGV command” using the entered full AGV ID.
steps.expected_result: The command is executed/accepted by the Aveva API interface for the specified AGV ID.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI proceeds to show a response (success or error) for the executed command.
steps.failure_condition: The UI returns an error or does not provide any response indicating acceptance/execution.

actions.label: Execute command
actions.exact_action: Execute the “Execute AGV command” for the specified full AGV ID.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the command cannot be executed or returns an error, stop and escalate to support for deeper troubleshooting.

steps.title: Verify the command was accepted/executed on the Aveva API side
steps.purpose: Confirm the recovery mechanism completed successfully (or identify error conditions immediately).
steps.instruction: Check the Aveva API response area for the executed “Execute AGV command” and confirm it indicates success/acceptance for the submitted AGV ID (no error shown for that AGV ID).
steps.expected_result: The Aveva API response indicates the command was accepted/executed for the specified AGV ID (i.e., no error shown for the submitted AGV ID).
steps.healthy_condition: A success/confirmation response is shown for the executed command.
steps.failure_condition: An error response is shown for the submitted AGV ID, or the response indicates the command was not accepted/executed.

actions.label: Review API response
actions.exact_action: Verify the Aveva API response for the executed “Execute AGV command” shows success (no error for the submitted AGV ID).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the command returns an error, stop and escalate to support for deeper troubleshooting.

success_criteria: The Aveva API “Execute AGV command” is executed using the full AGV ID, and the API response indicates success/acceptance (no error shown for the submitted AGV ID).
The recovery mechanism is used to mark the specified AGV task as completed despite RMS failing to send the callback.
healthy_conditions: Aveva API shows “Execute AGV command” and accepts the full AGV ID input.
API response indicates the command was accepted/executed successfully.
failure_conditions: Aveva API cannot execute the “Execute AGV command” or returns an error for the submitted AGV ID.
You cannot locate/select “Execute AGV command” on the Aveva API page.
escalation_guidance: If the command cannot be executed or returns an error, stop and escalate to support for deeper troubleshooting.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: The Aveva API page section showing recovery mechanisms including “Execute AGV command” (and its description about specifying an AGV ID when RMS fails to send a callback).

source_refs.quote_or_summary: In the event of an RMS crash, Execute AGV command enables users to specify an AGV ID that has completed its task when RMS fails to send a callback.
